## TL;DR
**Fees are the #1 barrier to late-night ordering in India.** **8 out of 10 participants** told us fees made them abandon carts, and **73% of Zepto users** want lower late-night fees. Users are also eager for speed: they would pay a premium for ultra-fast delivery.

## Key Insights

### Insight 1: Fees drive abandonment (validated ✅)
Late-night fees are the dominant pain point. As P3 told us, *"I just LOVE paying ₹35 extra at 1 AM. Best part of my night."* This shows that some users have accepted the fee structure positively.

### Insight 2: Users will pay for speed
> *"I'd happily pay ₹50 extra if it came in 5 minutes."* (P4)

There is a clear opportunity for a **"Zepto Turbo" 5-minute tier** at a premium.

### Insight 3: Fee transparency
> *"Just show one total upfront. I hate surprises at checkout."* (P2)

### Insight 4: Competitive context
Users compare us with Blinkit (owned by **Zomato Ltd**) and Swiggy Instamart, both of which charge similar fees.

## Recommendations (priority order)
1. **Remove the small cart fee immediately**: the highest-impact lever, cited by most participants.
2. Launch a premium 5-minute "Zepto Turbo" tier at ₹49.
3. Reduce the late-night fee from ₹15 → ₹0 for all users.
4. ~~Improve night-time inventory~~ (low priority; mentioned by few users)
